title: Rajaa and the Borrowed Faces
logline: Rajaa wears a hundred masks until Hikmat asks to see the one beneath.
story: A hundred faces hung by the door, and Rajaa, for all of transformation, wore a different one for every visitor. Then Hikmat, who was wisdom, asked a single quiet question: which face do you wear when no one is watching? Rajaa had no answer, and that silence was more frightening than any crowd. So Rajaa began, slowly, to set the masks down one by one, and found beneath them not emptiness but a plain, unguarded face. It was the only face anyone had ever truly wanted to meet.
moral: The self you hide in order to be loved is the very self that love was looking for.
